Definition: Paras (i.e. Persia), an Eastern country, including its inhabitants
BiblicalUsage: Paras is Persia, the eastern empire that succeeds Babylon. The ram with two horns stands for the kings of Media and Persia, Cyrus king of Persia makes his proclamation to rebuild the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, and Ahasuerus feasts the princes of Persia and Media.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Persia shows that God rules the empires: He names the kings of Persia in prophecy, then uses a Persian king to send His people home.
RelatedPeople: Daniel; Cyrus the Great; Queen Esther
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
